metadata.title: Tesla's Cybercab bet rewrites Germany's auto reset around automation

content.text:
Germany's automotive sector is confronting an increasingly difficult reset, as domestic manufacturers cut jobs, reassess production capacity, and face intensifying competition from Chinese rivals...
